TRADEMARK LICENSE AGREEMENT

This Trademark License Agreement is entered into on 1 December 2026 between:

Atelier Lumen GmbH, a company organized under the laws of Germany
Address: Musterweg 5, 80331 München, Germany
(the "Licensor")

and

Daon Interior Co., Ltd.
Address: 55, Eulji-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul 04535, Korea
(the "Licensee")

1. Grant of License
1.1 Licensor grants Licensee a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the trademark "LUMEN" (the "Trademark") on furniture products sold in the Republic of Korea.

2. Royalty
2.1 Licensee shall pay Licensor a royalty of five percent (5%) of the net sales of the Licensed Products.
2.2 Royalties shall be paid in EUR by bank transfer within thirty (30) days after the end of each calendar quarter.

3. Quality Control
3.1 Licensee shall submit samples of each Licensed Product to Licensor for approval before the first sale.

4. Term and Termination
4.1 This Agreement shall remain in force for three (3) years from the date hereof.
4.2 Either party may terminate this Agreement upon written notice if the other party materially breaches this Agreement and fails to cure within thirty (30) days.

5. Dispute Resolution
5.1 Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be finally settled under the Rules of Arbitration of the International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) by one arbitrator. The seat of arbitration shall be Paris, France, and the language of the arbitration shall be English.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement.

Daon Interior Co., Ltd.  By: ____________________
